quotable: matched wall-treatment contrast, same model family or implementation allowed (works)
the same with unreported controls as an upper bound (works)
transfer tests of a fitted treatment and their three statuses (tests and works)
not_quotable: matched contrast restricted to a change of model: the member count changed by more than the limit fixed in advance on the random sample
complete-system benchmark label: Cohen's kappa 0.15 on the random sample
coupled-LES label: the member count changed by more than the limit on the random sample
